schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Internal @ait-kit/* pins are rewritten by the Sampo release workflow (sync-internal-deps), so Renovate must never propose updates for them.

Bun version changes affect the lockfile format and pinned versions in GitHub workflows, and @types/bun must move in lockstep with the manually pinned runtime so typechecking cannot see APIs the runtime lacks; manage both manually.
Group dev-only patch/minor updates and automerge after CI passes.
Runtime dependencies ship inside published packages; require manual review plus a changeset.
